description: This Java source file defines a singleton class 'PolicyQueryCommandResponseMappingStrategies' that manages mapping strategies for different policy query command response signals in the context of a protocol adapter. It extends an abstract class and provides concrete implementations for mapping various response types to JSON-serializable objects.
